limitations: Length contrast is forced by grouping, not an independent validation result.
Longer sequences have more chances to contain a low minimum; minimum-confidence correlation alone is not behavioral proof.
149 censored training traces differ from completed subset; report both, no hidden exclusion.
Training greedy confidence is not sampling0.7 MATH500 confidence.
R itself responds to confidence, so paired confidence association is not proof of an intervention-independent detector.
Outcome-based underthinking proxy is not a proof that more reasoning would repair every individual error.
